name: WPYog Team
author: WPYog

sections.description:
WPYog Team lets you build and display a team grid on any page using a simple shortcode.

Features:
* Custom Post Types for Team Members and Teams
* Popup layout — click a card to see full member profile in a smooth modal
* Per-member fields: Designation, Sub Title, Short Description, rich bio (via WordPress editor)
* Contact details repeater (Tel, Email, etc.)
* Social media icons (60+ platforms)
* Column control (2–5 columns)
* Custom margin & padding per team
* Custom CSS per team
* Prev/Next navigation in the popup modal
* Keyboard accessible (Escape to close, arrow keys to navigate)
* Touch/swipe support on mobile

Usage:
1. Go to WPYog Team → Add New Member and create your team members.
2. Go to WPYog Team → Teams → Add Team to create a team, select members, and configure the layout.
3. Copy the shortcode [wpyogteam id="YOUR_ID"] and paste it on any page or post.
